title: StopptCOVID Study Data, Analysis and Results
required_attribution: Robert Koch Institute (RKI), StopptCOVID Study Data, Analysis and Results, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10888033.
notes: The source estimates COVID-19 cases by symptom-onset date.
The source header contains the spelling Altersgrupppe; the preparation script normalizes it to Altersgruppe.
The package aggregates the three age groups to a state-level daily epidemic trajectory for the primary experiment.
